content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Nonprofit fundraising and donor software; education administration is a small line, not instructional content or learning platforms."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Enterprise customer-service and knowledge software; no educational content, schools, or learner customers."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Technology research and advisory for executives; sells analysis to businesses, not instructional materials to educators."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Consumer lifestyle media monetized through advertising and affiliate commissions; no instructional content sold to schools."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Mainly news, business information and property portals; book publishing is one minor unit, not the core model."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Enterprise infrastructure and application development software sold to IT teams; no educational products or customers."},{"label":"C7","good":true,"reason":"Digital learning content, learning platforms, training and certification sold by subscription; overlaps target's platforms and certification, though corporate-focused."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Enterprise marketing and customer-experience software for brands; no education products or customers."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Operates virtual public schools paid per student; differs from selling curriculum and platforms to schools for a fee."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Sports and lifestyle media earning advertising and affiliate revenue; no educational publishing or school sales."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Enterprise work management and records software sold by subscription; no instructional content or education customers."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Consumer tech media and cybersecurity or speed-test software; advertising-driven, with no educational publishing."}]}
